rate_limits: Maximum 60 data downloads per hour; excess requests are temporarily blocked.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: replace; OECD states 60/hour, temporary blocking, VPN prohibition and parameter restrictions: https://www.oecd.org/en/data/insights/data-explainers/2024/11/Api-best-practices-and-recommendations.html. rate_limits: replace; 60/hour and temporary blocking: same URL. example: replace; current OECD guide documents the DF_CLI query and JSON format: https://www.oecd.org/en/data/insights/data-explainers/2024/09/api.html.
